name: ScummVM (point-and-click engines)
_notes: Not a console: a small abstract action set ScummVM (standalone keymapper or libretro core) can bind. pointer_x/pointer_y are a pointer target driven by the left stick; Steam trackpad-as-mouse also works with no binding. skip = Esc (skip cutscene), skip_line = '.', menu = the ScummVM global main menu (Ctrl+F5). [VERIFY] the action ids in ScummVM's keymapper. Per-engine keys (verbs, inventory) are left out.
